name: finit_module
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_finit_module, int fd, const char *param_values, int flags);
description: finit_module loads a kernel module from a file descriptor, similar to init_module, but reads the module directly from the filesystem. It allows for authenticity verification based on file location and supports flags to ignore version checks, requiring appropriate privileges.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the file containing the module to load

parameters.name: param_values
parameters.description: String containing space-delimited specifications of module parameter values

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bit mask of flags, such as MODULE_INIT_IGNORE_MODVERSIONS or MODULE_INIT_IGNORE_VERMAGIC, to modify loading behavior

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Timeout while trying to resolve a symbol reference by this module
An address argument referred to a location outside the process’s accessible address space
Module signature is invalid or the kernel does not have a key for this module
The caller was not privileged or module loading is disabled
The file referred to by fd is not opened for reading
The file referred to by fd is too large
fd does not refer to an open file
The file referred to by fd is opened for read-write
